function: Joint learned estimation of full RIS-user CSI from partial CSI (DSRNet) and compressed feedback and reconstruction at the BS over a noisy uplink (DCFNet) (pp. 1, 5).
system: MISO, BS with 9 antennas, passive reflecting RIS 36x36 = 1,296 elements (16 observe CSI), no direct link, NLoS only; band not stated (pp. 4, 8).
method: Supervised end-to-end CNN: DSRNet super-resolution and denoising estimator plus DCFNet attention encoder and denoising decoder, jointly trained with MSE, phase and amplitude losses (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing channels generated with the RISnet pipeline, LoS removed; 20,480 training and 1,024 test samples (p. 8).
test_conditions: Train and test on one dataset (separate 1,024 test samples), 16 observed RIS elements; SNR swept from -5 to 40 dB with noisy feedback; no other scenario (pp. 8-9).
baselines: Learned only: CsiNet, DCsiNet, CRNet, CLNet, DDCsiNet feedback nets; DnCNN, CBDNet decoders; UJEFNet end-to-end; two partial-CSI variants; no non-learned method (pp. 10-13).
metrics: NMSE (dB), PSNR (dB), complex correlation rho versus SNR; parameters, memory, inference time (pp. 8, 12-13).
complexity: Proposed: 592K parameters, 2.26 MB model size, 40.11 ms inference time; compared with CsiNet, DDCsiNet, UJEFNet (873K, 25.72 ms) in Tables 4 and 6-8 (pp. 9, 12-13).
openness: No code or own data released; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset through the RISnet generation pipeline (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 8: "DeepMIMO dataset [39]" Met: the datasets are generated following the RISnet framework from this ray-tracing-based public dataset.
q2_support: p. 8: "an independent test set of 1, 024 samples reserved for performance evaluation" Not met: a held-out part of the same dataset; only the SNR is swept, with no other RIS size, user setup, scenario or band, and no transfer or fine-tuning.
q3_support: p. 12: "Fig. 10 compares the proposed DCFNet with representative CSI feedback networks" Not met: every compared method is a learned network; LS, MMSE and compressive sensing appear only in related work (p. 3), not in the results.
q4_support: p. 13: "with 592K parameters and a model size of 2.26 MB" Tables 4 and 6-8 also give memory and inference time (40.11 ms).
q5_support: p. 8: "DeepMIMO dataset [39]" Met through the public DeepMIMO channel dataset; the authors release no code or data of their own and give no link.
notes: Area 2: joint CSI estimation and feedback for RIS (area 2 rather than 3, since no beamforming or RIS configuration is learned). ris=1: passive reflecting RIS, only 16 of 1,296 elements observe CSI (p. 8). q1=1 and q5=1 rest on the public DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset generated with the RISnet pipeline, LoS removed (p. 8); the carrier band is never stated. q2=0: held-out test set of the same dataset with an SNR sweep only (pp. 8-9). q3=0: all baselines are learned (CsiNet family, DnCNN, CBDNet, UJEFNet; pp. 10-13), and no non-learned method is compared. q4=1: parameters, model size and inference time (Tables 4, 6-8). Title and DOI on p. 1 match.
